summary.text: Greg Stoker is the Green Party nominee, a former U.S. Army Ranger and podcast host who describes himself as an anti-war activist. He announced his campaign on January 15, 2026, and was placed on the ballot by the party's March 21, 2026 convention. He has not held elected office.

paragraphs.text: Served in the U.S. Army as a Ranger and was deployed to Afghanistan four times, according to Middle East Eye.

Became known as an anti-war commentator and podcast host on social media, and joined the Global Sumud Flotilla to Gaza in late September 2025, where he was arrested when Israeli forces boarded the vessels, according to Middle East Eye.

Announced his bid for Texas's 31st District in an Instagram video on January 15, 2026, saying he would not accept money from political action committees or corporate donors; advanced as the Green Party nominee at its March 21, 2026 convention.

sources.title: Former US soldiers turned Palestine advocates make a run for Congress
